_comment: Real, published public price points for parts comparable to the reference library. `part` must match a manifest id; `config` (optional) matches a config label — leave it out to show the point on every configuration of that part. Only add numbers you can cite; the harness prints exactly what is here and never invents a figure. Retrieved 2026-10-28.

entries.text: SendCutSend published routing example: ABS .125" (3.2 mm), 3.5 × 3.5 in profile, CNC routed — $7.42 @ qty 1, $2.99 @ qty 100 (smaller/thinner than this plate; no setup fee, 'general estimates')
SendCutSend published routing example: ABS .125", 3.5 × 3.5 in — $7.42 @ qty 1, $2.99 @ qty 100 (their smallest instant-quote part is 1 × 2 in; no minimum quantity)

Unionfab vendor comparison (instant quotes pulled 2025-12-05) for a 41 × 52 × 35 mm 6061-T6 block, qty 500, as-machined: Xometry USA $14.24–$37.51/unit (lead 8–20 d), Fictiv USA $23.08–$28.17/unit, Protolabs Network (overseas) $8.50–$9.61/unit
PREMSA Industries published reference range (NOT a quote): 'Delrin plate, 2.5D contours, pockets, mounting holes, 10–25 mm thick' — $35–$90 @ qty 1
PREMSA Industries published reference range (NOT a quote): '6061 spacer, cylindrical body with through hole' — $15–$35 @ qty 1
PREMSA Industries published reference range (NOT a quote; 1018 steel, not brass): 'bushing, OD 15–50 mm, length 20–60 mm' — $25–$70 @ qty 1
PREMSA Industries published reference range (NOT a quote; 6061, not Delrin): 'housing with deep cavities, thin walls, bosses' — $300–$1,000+ @ qty 1
JLC3DP published material rate (2025-08-13): MJF PA12 nylon $0.275/g → this 65.4 cm³ part ≈ 66 g ≈ $18.2 before post-processing (MJF, not FDM; overseas)
JLC3DP published material rate (2025-08-13): MJF PA12 nylon $0.275/g → this 43.4 cm³ disc ≈ 44 g ≈ $12.1 before post-processing (MJF, not FDM; overseas)
Manufacturing.net (2018, 3D Hubs network, unspecified test bracket): FDM PLA one-off prototype 'less than $8'; same bracket CNC in Delrin/ABS/Nylon one-off ≈ $100

notes: The authoritative benchmark for this shop is Xometry's own instant quote: as an active Xometry partner the owner can upload the 17 STL files in tools/vet-quotes/parts/ to xometry.com and paste the qty 1 / 10 / 25 numbers into the Owner's price column. Xometry, Protolabs and Fictiv publish no example prices on their material/service pages (checked 2026-10-28: xometry.com FDM and UHMW pages, protolabs.com Delrin page, sendcutsend.com HDPE page) — their numbers only come out of the quote tool.

SendCutSend's routing example is the only published plastic-routing price point found. Their model has no per-job setup charge, which is why their qty-1 price ($7.42) is an order of magnitude under this engine's qty-1 routing prices (routerSetupCost = $60 is amortised over the quantity).

PREMSA ranges are editorial reference ranges compiled by that shop's engineers and explicitly 'not a rate card'; they are included because they are published, dated and specific about the part type. Treat them as a sanity band, not a quote.
A hubs.com knowledge-base page on CNC cost could not be fetched from this environment (blocked), so no Protolabs Network example is included beyond the Unionfab comparison.
